description: Seed problems for matched generation: each has a strong (reference) spec and a trusted reference implementation. Used as phi_strong for coupling and as the differential-testing oracle.

problems.problem_nl: Return the maximum of two integers.
problems.signature: method Max(a: int, b: int) returns (r: int)
problems.reference_impl: if a >= b { r := a; } else { r := b; }

problems.problem_nl: Return the minimum of two integers.
problems.signature: method Min(a: int, b: int) returns (r: int)
problems.reference_impl: if a <= b { r := a; } else { r := b; }

problems.problem_nl: Return the absolute value of x.
problems.reference_impl: if x < 0 { r := -x; } else { r := x; }

problems.problem_nl: Return the sum of two integers.
problems.signature: method SumPair(a: int, b: int) returns (r: int)
